rate_offered.notes: Nominal annual rate before tax, as printed for the 1,000-99,999 tier; the row also prints 'ריבית מתואמת: 1.80%' (effective annual, BANK-04) and 'הטבת דיגיטל לפיקדון שכיח (נומינלי שנתי): 0.15%' (whether the digital benefit is included in or added to the 1.80% is not stated). Other tiers on the same page: 100,000-249,999: 1.90% (ריבית מתואמת 1.90%); 250,000 ומעלה: 2.00% (ריבית מתואמת 2.00%). The page says the offered rate is for the end of the deposit period and the binding terms are in the deposit agreement. The page prints 'הנתונים נכונים ליום 25.10.2026', two days after the read date (see report). Rates change at the bank's discretion.

source.title: Income Tax Ordinance s.125C(c)(1): 15% on interest from an asset not linked to the CPI (Hebrew Wikisource mirror); read through il-finance TXI-03 and TXI-04

tax_bucket.notes: Unlinked shekel deposit ('לא צמוד'): interest taxed at 15% of the nominal interest (TXI-03); 'linked' means CPI or exchange rate, so an unlinked or prime-linked shekel deposit is in this bucket (TXI-04); the bank withholds 15% (TXI-08).
